policy: Primary publications, author repositories, institutional records and patent text. Publication metadata is not treated as full-paper access. No outside performance number is used to calibrate the placement experiment.

sources.title: 3D-FPIM official artifact
sources.publication_context: Artifact for MICRO 2022 paper; audited repository commit last authored in May 2023
sources.read_depth: README and complete compiler paths for matrix construction, placement, movement insertion, scheduling, register allocation and code serialization; pertinent NVSim geometry/decoder/precharger/capacitor paths; quantized linear implementation. Compiler and NVSim built; original and adapted static traces generated. No public numerical instruction executor found.
evidence: common.h:128x128x64-depth MVMU, one MVMU/core, 24 cores/tile, maximum 224 tiles.
operations.cpp:526-579 builds each MVM group at depths 0 through nStack-1; isLast marks its final MVM.
codegen.cpp:129-158 serializes depth, stacks, precision, slideId and isLast; line34 states binary ABI is TODO.
regalloc.cpp:248-254 treats non-last MVMs as not writing a register.
linearizer.cpp:190-245 MVM guard derives from last input load; not an accumulator reset definition.
include/3dfpim.h:245-258 declares ModelInstance.bind/generateData; corresponding implementation not found.
Cap.cpp models area/energy, not execution state or clear signals. SubArray.cpp bitline-discharge comments do not establish integrator reset semantics.
sources.inference: Compiler depth fields permit a plausible software offset representation, but independent nonzero-depth groups, weight programming and physical accumulator reset remain unverified. Absence of an adapter does not prove new hardware is required.
sources.maturity: Published simulated architecture, public compiler/circuit model; not manufactured hardware or a complete runnable numerical chip model.

sources.title: 3D-FPIM: An Extreme Energy-Efficient DNN Acceleration System Using 3D NAND Flash-Based In-Situ PIM Unit
sources.read_depth: Primary author/lab publication entries and institutional abstract/metadata only. Original full paper not obtained. Author homepage repository recursive tree has no paper PDF. MICRO2022 official program lists the session without paper/talk files. IEEE public page requires JavaScript challenge. IDEC listing confirms title but no accessible full paper obtained.
sources.not_claimed: No original-paper figure, page, ADC-reset signal, random-depth latency or programmer contract is cited as read.

sources.title: Function-based activation of memory tiers
sources.read_depth: Application abstract; detailed description associated with Figures1-3,8A/B,10A/B; claims1-17. Official grant29-page PDF downloaded and cover visually inspected to verify grant/date, not read in full.
sources.evidence: Description explicitly includes 3D NAND as a possible nonvolatile substrate. Different experts may occupy different tiers of the same physical tile, may span tiers/tiles, and are dynamically selected by expert index/wordline circuitry. Selected experts execute successively; converted outputs are gate-scaled and accumulated. Figures8 and10 address multiple selected experts.
sources.inference: The concept of exploiting inactive depth to co-store and select MoE experts is direct prior art. No learned anti-coactivation placement algorithm was identified in the read portions. Patent architecture capability is not evidence that 3D-FPIM implements its tier-selection contract.
sources.code: No runnable artifact identified in this source.
sources.legal_scope: Technical prior-art comparison only; no patent validity or infringement opinion.

sources.title: 3D-aCortex: An Ultra-Compact Energy-Efficient Neurocomputing Platform Based on Commercial 3D-NAND Flash Memories
sources.version: arXiv1908.02472; PDF header August2019,2nd revision; journal metadata not independently audited this turn
sources.read_depth: Sections2.1-2.2 and4.1-4.3; relevant Figures7-9 captions and controller description. Not all device experiments or quantitative results.
sources.evidence: Section2.1 explicitly resets capacitor voltages before an operation. Section2.2 selects an arbitrary memory layer, applying inputs through BSLs; the sweep phase uses a designated layer. Section4.2 defines Vreset-connected capacitor pass gates, layer selection and temporal partial-output accumulation. Section4.3 quantizes/reshapes kernels and performs randomized-order greedy 3D weight packing, searching already-used layers before allocating another.
sources.inference: Strong dense-kernel depth-packing prior and a published backend with clearer reset/select semantics. It does not establish 3D-FPIM's missing contract; its reserved sweep layer and precision differ.
sources.code: The manuscript describes a software framework. No public author simulator repository verified in this audit.
sources.maturity: Circuit/system simulations of a proposed processor using commercial NAND array technology; not a commercial inference chip.

sources.title: Technological Design of 3D NAND-Based Compute-in-Memory Architecture for GB-Scale Deep Neural Network
sources.read_depth: Institutional abstract/metadata only for original four-page article. Official author ASP-DAC2024 tutorial slide36, zero-based PDFpage35, inspected; it explicitly diagrams Google's MoE experts and cites this EDL paper.
sources.evidence: The tutorial associates NAND capacity with a multi-expert model and shows input buffer, wordline selectors, bitline MUX/ADC, adder/shifter and output buffer.
sources.inference: Earlier direct NAND/MoE context. Fine-grained expert-to-depth mapping and numerical isolation cannot be inferred from the abstract/tutorial figure alone.
sources.not_claimed: Original paper fulltext or a runnable author simulator was not obtained. Online2020 DOI does not change issue year2021.

sources.title: NITRO: High-Performance 3D NAND Flash-Based In-Storage Computing with Enhanced Activation Dataflow
sources.version: arXiv2608.11920v1, submitted2026-08-12; manuscript says extended DATE2026 paper
sources.read_depth: Abstract, introduction, background and architecture overview through SectionIII.A; text search for relevant 3D-FPIM references. No full architecture/circuit audit.
sources.evidence: Describes 3D-FPIM as analog NAND-PIM and identifies its quantization-aware conversion and low-power decoder. Proposes distributed intra-plane mapping and activation buffering as architecture changes.
sources.inference: Useful recent physical-dataflow prior; this secondary description of 3D-FPIM does not fill its reset/programmer semantics. NITRO's new architecture cannot be inserted into the present backend as an existing instruction.
sources.not_claimed: No NITRO code, numerical accuracy result, or timing calibration is asserted from the portions read.
